title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental — Free Move-In Truck Eligibility and Pickup Window
content:
**Offer terms — who may claim the free move-in truck of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental, on which vehicle, and when.**

### Terms in force

1. A tenant moving into a Bluegate storage unit may claim one free move-in truck for that unit on a vehicle class marked eligible for the free move-in truck on the class terms.
2. The linked unit rental must be in reserved or active status and belong to the same customer.
3. The free move-in truck may be claimed only when the pickup date is not later than the unit move-in date plus the class's pickup-window days, and not earlier than the move-in date minus the same number of days for a reserved unit whose move-in is scheduled.
4. Window days are calendar days counted from the day after the move-in date, and the last counted day is included.
5. Extra periods, extra miles, fuel, damage waiver, cleaning and damage stay chargeable on a free move-in contract.
6. A unit rental that has reached delinquent status or ended does not support the benefit.

The status, the owner and the move-in date of the storage unit are read from the storage unit rental agreement named on the claim, the pickup date from the truck contract's actual pickup date, and the class from the vehicle class on the truck contract — all from the company's records.

### Retired term

7. On a free move-in contract the charges on the class's waived-charge list for the first rental period are credited in full as a free move-in waiver, and the first included miles of the class are not charged. — This term is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis of the free move-in rental waiver and the included-miles credit. The class waived-charge list itself stands on the schedule unchanged: base rental fee and environmental fee for the Bluegate Pickup Truck, Bluegate Cargo Van, Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck and Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck; none for the Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck and Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck.

## Window boundaries (hypothetical move-in date of 10 March, 7-day window)

| Pickup date | Count of window days | Inside the window |
|---|---|---|
| 17 March | Day 7 counted from 11 March, the last counted day | Yes — the last counted day is included |
| 18 March | Day 8 | No — later than the move-in date plus 7 days |
| 3 March, reserved unit with move-in scheduled for 10 March | 7 days before the move-in date | Yes — not earlier than the move-in date minus 7 days |
| 2 March, reserved unit with move-in scheduled for 10 March | 8 days before the move-in date | No — earlier than the move-in date minus 7 days |

## Unit standing (from the storage unit rental agreement)

| Storage unit agreement | Supports the benefit |
|---|---|
| Reserved, same customer | Yes (term 2) |
| Active, same customer | Yes (term 2) |
| Delinquent | No (term 6) |
| Ended | No (term 6) |
| Belonging to a different customer | No (term 2) |

superseded_clauses: On a free move-in contract the charges in free_move_in_waived_charges for the first rental period are credited in full as free_move_in_waiver, and the first free_move_in_included_miles miles are not charged.
